dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the anterior head region and sharp linear convergence toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a slight convex bulge on the right medial side where the body meets the water line.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature light-grey to white; high reflectance on the right dorsal flank with a deep longitudinal shadow obscuring the left lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of dark-pixel pinprick clusters localized primarily across the central and anterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary reflective canvas and the shadowed left flank; sharp transitions at the blowhole and scattered mottle points.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, high-contrast point marks scattered across the mid-back; faint, light-colored linear streaks visible on the right dorsal flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct circular indentation at the blowhole; prominent raised longitudinal ridge extending along the posterior central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear marks on the right lateral surface consistent with superficial rake marks or healed epidermal scratches.
other_distinctive_markers: The posterior dorsal ridge is sharply defined, creating a distinct geometric bisector on the tailward half of the visible body.
